meaning:
σχίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע ;]
to cleave, rend: Mat.27:51, Mrk.1:10 15:38, Luk.5:36 23:45, Jhn.19:24 21:11; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, Act.14:4 23:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will…
Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They…
But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
